audit_title: QuantEngine Phase 174 Independent Economics Reconciliation, Gate Integrity & Evidence-Calibrated Execution Findings

findings.summary: Phase 172 and Phase 173 release candidate archives verified byte-for-byte against detached records
findings.description: QuantEngine_PHASE172_RELEASE_CANDIDATE.zip (56,809,944 bytes, SHA-256 67d3e60e88f21c7c53fd5c0d0b5fbfc7f789df65099fe9636c2b6ffc8d33571c) and QuantEngine_PHASE173_RELEASE_CANDIDATE.zip (56,845,919 bytes, SHA-256 db88433208b4059369734c6e6f2e9c7aa1fc7c6193bed93c5d6392e79bae0e8e) independently audited. ZIP integrity, CRC checksums, member paths, and detached hash records match byte-for-byte with zero corruption or path traversal.
findings.mitigation: Preserve baseline release records unchanged in parent directory.

findings.summary: 50-point setup historical discrepancy (-$0.0051 vs -$0.0248) conclusively resolved
findings.description: Proved that -$0.00511580 USD in phase172_post_cost_backtest_results.json derives from the Symmetric Maker model ($0.0500 gross - $0.03871580 maker fees - $0.01640000 adverse selection). Proved that -$0.02480000 USD in PHASE172_FRICTION_GATE_BACKTEST.md derives from a flat $0.07480000 USD cost allowance ($0.0584 fee baseline + $0.0164 adverse selection) applied across all micro-setups (<50 pts). Both formulas reproduced to 8 decimal places.
findings.mitigation: Document the distinct assumptions of both models explicitly in P&L reconciliation reports.

findings.summary: 150-point setup rounding convention audited; non-fill drag proven counterfactual
findings.description: Recalculated 0.1500 - 0.06782050 - 0.01640000 - 0.01380420 = 0.05197530 USD. Proved that published +$0.0519 USD reflects 4-decimal truncation (floor rounding), while standard ROUND_HALF_UP produces +$0.0520 USD. Proved that $0.01380420 USD non-fill drag is a counterfactual benchmark comparison metric, NOT an observed cashflow or balance debit.
findings.mitigation: Enforce explicit precision rounding policy (ROUND_HALF_UP) and prohibit deducting counterfactual opportunity drag from realized ledger equity.

findings.summary: 400-point and 1000-point setups reconciled between Symmetric Maker and Asymmetric models
findings.description: Reconciled 400-pt (+0.3448 vs +0.3017) and 1000-pt (+0.9447 vs +0.9016). Proved that the ~$0.0430 USD delta corresponds exactly to the taker exit fee surcharge (3.54 bps on notional = ~$0.0292 USD) plus the counterfactual non-fill penalty ($0.0138 USD). All intermediate fee, tax, and adverse selection components verified.
findings.mitigation: Maintain clear scenario labels when comparing pure maker liquidity provision against taker-exit protective brackets.

findings.summary: Friction hurdle rule subsumption formally proved; fail-closed safety fortified
findings.description: Mathematically proved that Rule 1 (Fee Ratio <= 40%) strictly subsumes Rule 2 (Target Multiple >= 2.0x <=> Fee Ratio <= 50%). Proved Rule 3 (Post-Fee R:R >= 1.25) acts as an independent constraint. Fortified evaluate_friction_hurdle to safely fail closed on NaN, Inf, None, negative prices, and non-positive quantities without crashing.
findings.mitigation: Enforce fail-closed verification across all candidate evaluation pipelines.

findings.summary: Queue dynamics 7 operational questions answered; block-hazard assumption formalized
findings.description: Formally audited queue mathematics: lambda represents contract volume arrival rate (contracts/sec); Q represents estimated depth ahead; formula 1 - exp(-lambda*t/Q) represents a memoryless exponential block hazard, which yields 86.47% any-fill and 86.20% complete-fill. Contrasted against an Erlang-Q Poisson count model (>99.9999%), proving the block-hazard model is a conservative simulation assumption. Retained strictly as SIMULATION_ASSUMPTION.
findings.mitigation: Never classify queue dynamics results as empirical observations without high-frequency Market-by-Order (MBO) order-level feeds.

findings.summary: Paper trading engine isolation verified; zero live adapter invocation proved
findings.description: QueueAwarePaperExecutionEngine verified through complete order lifecycle (CREATED -> VALIDATED -> RESTING -> PARTIALLY_FILLED -> FILLED). Invariant assert_no_live_adapter_invocation() tested and confirmed passing with zero live adapter calls.
findings.mitigation: Retain hard-coded zero live adapter guards across all paper trading and backtest runners.
